name: AI Attorney: Neuro-sama
summary:
In 2032, Vedal succeeded in creating two functional bodies for his twin AIs. In his expansion of VedalAI, he created a legal division to get him and his employees out of trouble. Without a lawyer to lead the department, he tasked Neuro-sama to become the first AI defence lawyer. Understanding the popularity he can gain from owning both the first defence and prosecution lawyers, he sent Evil to become the first AI prosecutor. After a streamed arduous journey, they pass the bar exam and became real lawyers.

After a few days of becoming an official lawyer, Neuro is called up by Vedal not to congratulate her but for a pressing issue. He’s been accused of Filian’s murder and needs Neuro to defend him. With Neuro-sama’s first case decided, she embarks on a journey of chaos and mayhem through the legal system.
